name: Sheraton Kauai Coconut Beach Resort
positioning: Beachfront resort near Kapaa on Kauai's east side, with a zero-edge pool overlooking the ocean, rooms with private lanais and the open-air Luau Ka Hikina
best_for: Travelers who want a central beachfront base for exploring Kauai
Families who want a pool with a separate children's area
Guests interested in hula, ukulele and lei-making lessons

facts.text: The resort is set right on the beach and centrally located near Kapaa and Lihue Airport.
The Zero Edge pool overlooks the ocean, just steps away from the beach.
The infinity-edge pool has separate areas for children and adults, surrounded by an oceanfront bar, lounge chairs and fire pits.
Guest rooms feature private lanais and mini-refrigerators.
Most rooms have a view of the ocean.
The Ocean Front Suite has a living and dining area with a wet bar, an ocean-view king bedroom, a glass-enclosed shower and a soaking tub.
Luau Ka Hikina takes place beside the island's historic royal surfing grounds in the open-air Halau Ho'okipa pavilion with ocean views.
Guests can book lei making, yoga, ukulele lessons and hula lessons at the resort.
The resort is close to the Sleeping Giant trailhead, Opaekaa Falls and Wailua River State Park, which includes Wailua Falls.
Guests can take a kayak tour of the Wailua River.
Moa Moa serves seafood and Pacific Island cuisine in an open-air setting with ocean and beach views.

highlights.text: Luau Ka Hikina takes place beside the island's historic royal surfing grounds in the open-air Halau Ho'okipa pavilion with ocean views.
The Zero Edge pool overlooks the ocean just steps from the beach, with separate areas for children and adults and fire pits around it.
The resort is set right on the beach and centrally located near Kapaa and Lihue Airport.
The Ocean Front Suite has a living and dining area with a wet bar, an ocean-view king bedroom and a soaking tub.
Guests can book lei making, yoga, ukulele lessons and hula lessons at the resort.

considerations.text: Lihue Airport is approximately 6.2 miles from the hotel.
The minimum age to check in is 21.
WhataHotel notes the resort is large, so amenities can be a walk apart.
